cat > /app/plot_chart.py << 'PY'
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

events = data['energy_transition_events']['data']
share = data['clean_energy_generation_share']['data']

# Style: editorial, authoritative, publication-ready
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 16,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15, 8), dpi=180)

# Professional color palette
colors = {
    'coal': '#4E4E4E',
    'oil': '#7A5C3E',
    'gas': '#5F7A8A',
    'solar': '#F4B400',
    'wind': '#2A9D8F',
    'hydrogen': '#3A86FF'
}

# Baseline tracks
ax.axhline(1.0, color='#9AA0A6', lw=1.1, alpha=0.8)
ax.axhline(-1.0, color='#9AA0A6', lw=1.1, alpha=0.8)

# Inflection zone highlight (2015-2025)
ax.axvspan(2015, 2025, color='#E9F2FF', alpha=0.65, zorder=0)
ax.text(2020, 2.2, 'Inflection zone (2015–2025)', ha='center', va='center', color='#355070', fontsize=10)

# Overlay clean generation share (scaled to secondary y visual band)
years_share = [d['year'] for d in share]
share_vals = [d['clean_share_pct'] for d in share]

# Map share percentage range to y between -0.1 and +0.7 (between tracks)
min_s, max_s = min(share_vals), max(share_vals)
scaled = [ -0.1 + (v - min_s) / (max_s - min_s) * 0.8 for v in share_vals ]

ax.fill_between(years_share, -0.1, scaled, color='#A8DADC', alpha=0.25, zorder=1)
ax.plot(years_share, scaled, color='#1D3557', lw=2.3, zorder=2)

# Label a few share points with units
for year, val, y in zip(years_share, share_vals, scaled):
    if year in (2000, 2010, 2020, 2025, 2030, 2035):
        ax.text(year, y+0.08, f'{val:.1f}%', color='#1D3557', fontsize=9, ha='center')

# Jitter events by year within each track to avoid overplotting
clean_counts = {}
fossil_counts = {}
for e in events:
    year = e['year']
    if e['track'] == 'clean':
        clean_counts[year] = clean_counts.get(year, 0) + 1
    else:
        fossil_counts[year] = fossil_counts.get(year, 0) + 1

clean_seen = {}
fossil_seen = {}

for e in events:
    year = e['year']
    sig = e['significance']
    subtype = e['sub_type']
    track = e['track']

    if track == 'clean':
        idx = clean_seen.get(year, 0)
        total = clean_counts[year]
        clean_seen[year] = idx + 1
        jitter = (idx - (total - 1)/2) * 0.12
        y = 1.0 + jitter
        edge = '#1F2937'
    else:
        idx = fossil_seen.get(year, 0)
        total = fossil_counts[year]
        fossil_seen[year] = idx + 1
        jitter = (idx - (total - 1)/2) * 0.12
        y = -1.0 + jitter
        edge = '#111827'

    size = 28 + sig * 24
    ax.scatter(year, y, s=size, color=colors[subtype], edgecolor=edge, linewidth=0.55, alpha=0.95, zorder=3)

# Axis formatting
ax.set_xlim(2000, 2035)
ax.set_ylim(-2.2, 2.4)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(2000, 2036, 5))
ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_yticks([1.0, -1.0])
ax.set_yticklabels(['Clean energy milestones', 'Fossil retirement events'])
ax.set_ylabel('Transition track')

ax.set_title('Global Energy Transition Timeline: Fossil Retirement vs Clean Milestones (2000–2035)')

# Subtype legend
subtype_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=colors['coal'], markeredgecolor='#1f1f1f', markersize=8, label='Coal'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=colors['oil'], markeredgecolor='#1f1f1f', markersize=8, label='Oil'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=colors['gas'], markeredgecolor='#1f1f1f', markersize=8, label='Gas'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=colors['solar'], markeredgecolor='#1f1f1f', markersize=8, label='Solar'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=colors['wind'], markeredgecolor='#1f1f1f', markersize=8, label='Wind'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=colors['hydrogen'], markeredgecolor='#1f1f1f', markersize=8, label='Hydrogen'),
]

# Significance size legend
size_vals = [3, 6, 9]
size_handles = [plt.scatter([], [], s=28 + v*24, color='#9AA0A6', edgecolor='#374151', linewidth=0.5) for v in size_vals]

share_handle = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color='#1D3557', lw=2.3, label='Clean generation share (line, %)'),
    Patch(facecolor='#A8DADC', alpha=0.25, label='Clean generation share area')
]

leg1 = ax.legend(handles=subtype_handles, ncol=6, loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.11), frameon=False, title='Energy sub-type')
ax.add_artist(leg1)

leg2 = ax.legend(size_handles, [f'Significance {v}' for v in size_vals], loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.98), frameon=True, title='Marker size scale')
ax.add_artist(leg2)

leg3 = ax.legend(handles=share_handle, loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.99, 0.98), frameon=True)

# Annotation for overlay units
ax.text(2000.3, -0.25, 'Overlay line/area shows clean electricity generation share (%)', color='#1D3557', fontsize=9)

ax.grid(axis='x', color='#D1D5DB', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.6)
for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=220, bbox_inches='tight')

import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    d=json.load(f)

events=d['energy_transition_events']['data']
share=d['clean_energy_generation_share']['data']

W,H=1800,1100
mL,mR,mT,mB=120,80,100,130
plotW=W-mL-mR
plotH=H-mT-mB

img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
dr=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
font=ImageFont.load_default()

# colors
colors={
 'coal':'#4E4E4E','oil':'#7A5C3E','gas':'#5F7A8A',
 'solar':'#F4B400','wind':'#2A9D8F','hydrogen':'#3A86FF'
}

def hx(c):
    c=c.lstrip('#');return tuple(int(c[i:i+2],16) for i in (0,2,4))

# axes mapping
x0,x1=2000,2035

def X(y): return mL+(y-x0)/(x1-x0)*plotW

y_min,y_max=-2.2,2.4
def Y(v): return mT+(y_max-v)/(y_max-y_min)*plotH

# inflection zone
dr.rectangle([X(2015),mT,X(2025),mT+plotH],fill=(233,242,255))

# grid + x ticks
for yr in range(2000,2036,5):
    x=X(yr)
    dr.line([x,mT,x,mT+plotH],fill=(220,220,220),width=1)
    dr.text((x-12,mT+plotH+10),str(yr),fill=(40,40,40),font=font)

# track lines
for yv in [1.0,-1.0]:
    y=Y(yv)
    dr.line([mL,y,mL+plotW,y],fill=(140,145,150),width=2)

# clean share line (scaled)
years=[p['year'] for p in share]
vals=[p['clean_share_pct'] for p in share]
mn,mx=min(vals),max(vals)
pts=[]
for yr,val in zip(years,vals):
    y=-0.1+(val-mn)/(mx-mn)*0.8
    pts.append((X(yr),Y(y),val))

# fill
poly=[(pts[0][0],Y(-0.1))]+[(p[0],p[1]) for p in pts]+[(pts[-1][0],Y(-0.1))]
dr.polygon(poly,fill=(168,218,220))
for i in range(len(pts)-1):
    dr.line([pts[i][0],pts[i][1],pts[i+1][0],pts[i+1][1]],fill=(29,53,87),width=3)

# event points
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
cc=Counter(e['year'] for e in events if e['track']=='clean')
fc=Counter(e['year'] for e in events if e['track']=='fossil')
seen_c=defaultdict(int); seen_f=defaultdict(int)
for e in events:
    yr=e['year']; sig=e['significance']; st=e['sub_type']
    if e['track']=='clean':
        idx=seen_c[yr]; seen_c[yr]+=1; tot=cc[yr]; y=1.0+(idx-(tot-1)/2)*0.12
    else:
        idx=seen_f[yr]; seen_f[yr]+=1; tot=fc[yr]; y=-1.0+(idx-(tot-1)/2)*0.12
    x=X(yr); yy=Y(y); r=3+sig*1.8
    dr.ellipse([x-r,yy-r,x+r,yy+r],fill=hx(colors[st]),outline=(20,20,20),width=1)

# labels/title
dr.text((mL,30),'Global Energy Transition Timeline: Fossil Retirement vs Clean Milestones (2000–2035)',fill=(15,15,15),font=font)
dr.text((mL,50),'X-axis: Year | Y-axis: Transition track (clean above, fossil below) | Overlay: Clean electricity generation share (%)',fill=(50,50,50),font=font)
dr.text((mL-70,mT+plotH//2),'Track',fill=(40,40,40),font=font)
dr.text((W//2-20,H-40),'Year',fill=(40,40,40),font=font)
dr.text((X(2020)-70,Y(2.15)),'Inflection zone (2015–2025)',fill=(53,80,112),font=font)
dr.text((mL+10,Y(1.15)),'Clean energy milestones',fill=(30,30,30),font=font)
dr.text((mL+10,Y(-0.85)),'Fossil retirement events',fill=(30,30,30),font=font)

# percent annotations
for yr,val in [(2000,19.2),(2010,21.7),(2020,31.5),(2025,42.0),(2030,52.0),(2035,62.0)]:
    y=-0.1+(val-mn)/(mx-mn)*0.8
    dr.text((X(yr)-12,Y(y)-16),f'{val:.1f}%',fill=(29,53,87),font=font)

# legend
lx,ly=W-520,130
dr.rectangle([lx,ly,lx+470,ly+280],fill=(255,255,255),outline=(120,120,120),width=2)
dr.text((lx+12,ly+10),'Legend',fill=(20,20,20),font=font)
subs=['coal','oil','gas','solar','wind','hydrogen']
for i,s in enumerate(subs):
    yy=ly+35+i*22
    dr.ellipse([lx+12,yy,lx+28,yy+16],fill=hx(colors[s]),outline=(20,20,20))
    dr.text((lx+36,yy+2),s.capitalize(),fill=(30,30,30),font=font)
dr.line([lx+220,ly+45,lx+270,ly+45],fill=(29,53,87),width=3)
dr.text((lx+278,ly+38),'Clean generation share (%)',fill=(30,30,30),font=font)
dr.rectangle([lx+220,ly+68,lx+270,ly+84],fill=(168,218,220),outline=(120,120,120))
dr.text((lx+278,ly+68),'Share area overlay',fill=(30,30,30),font=font)
for j,sig in enumerate([3,6,9]):
    r=3+sig*1.8; cy=ly+120+j*36
    dr.ellipse([lx+228-r,cy-r,lx+228+r,cy+r],fill=(154,160,166),outline=(60,60,60))
    dr.text((lx+260,cy-6),f'Significance {sig}',fill=(30,30,30),font=font)
dr.text((lx+12,ly+240),'Units: share in percent (%)',fill=(50,50,50),font=font)

img.save('/app/output/result.png')
